changes: Fixed map mode not properly re-enabling UI elements when switched off.
Fixed issue where burn gizmo/markers were disappearing as you manipulated the burn beyond the SOI or when the camera was actually closer to the sun than the marker.
Add bathymetry data and settings, set correct ocean level. Terrain height is now determined by Maximum and Minimum height settings, the range of the heightmap is distributed evenly between these two
Filter terrain mesh height based on adjacency data, precompute data used for runtime filtering, reduces visible mesh shimmering/instability at long distances and on LOD changes

Generate an ocean mask to filter and stabilize the ocean shores at large distances, prevent ocean from eating the terrain even if the terrain mesh shifts. Downsample the ocean mask with bicubic filtering
Add support for external views in shaderReadLayout in computePipelineWrapper
Move common UBO buffer in GenerateMeshHeight and GenerateMeshNormals to common include file
Remove confusing HEIGHT_SCALE constant in planetRendenderer, can just modify config files directly for testing
Fix mistake in shared.glsl nice height sampling function assuming texture dimensions are square
Add lod and trilinear overloads to textureNiceAccurate
Make atmospheric scattering see the water surface
Fix ocean transparency not affected by fresnel
Sample BC4 heightmaps in CPU height sampling function
Use per-thread CommandPool to prevent cross-thread Vulkan access violations when generating spherical billboards
Remove unnecessary cast before calling oceanRenderer
Minor refactors in cloudDetailMaps and oceanRenderData
Fix OceanRenderer.Render() expecting wrong type
Reverted another case of overaggressive maneuver->burn name change.

Reverted my change which prevented spawning thread workers while paused and Jamie's change which reverted my change, but in a different way. This resets the total state back to how it was, which I think is overall less confusing.
Fixed an error where updated vehicle state vectors could be thrown away if the vehicle flight plan was also recomputed on the same frame.
Modified line widths to lower the maximum screen size a major axis can become.
Fixed some celestial billboarding issues. They no longer are positionally behind a frame. Behavior should be closer aligned to how it was before the unit conversion.
Changed map drag to use right click to align with orbit controls.
Fixed the orbiting box hover logic falling out of sync with whether or not the box was drawn.
Fixed an issue when re-following the currently followed astronomical while in map controller.
moved default "game settings" flare intensity to 1.0 (from 0.3)
changed all flare color scalar in debug to 0.3 (from 1.0)
the net result is the same, but this normalizes the game settings to 1.0
current users will experience 70% less flare unless they restore the game settings to 1.0
Resolved a merge conflict involving an empty space in Astronomical.cs
Fixed infinite points on intergalactic visitors orbit lines.
Fixed the logic for showing/not showing burn gizmos and orbit lines hopefully once and for all. Begone ye Dragons!
Fixed - Missed a bit from the last commit.
Fixed - Don't highlight orbit points if the orbit itself is not being rendered.

Fixed orbit line of celestial not being drawn for the celestial the camera is following. Lesson for me - don't get cutesie and changing an if statement just before you commit without actually testing it fully.
Fixed so the ShowOrbitLinesAlways setting bool will now honour the show orbit toggles for all the celestials.
Changed the name of the OrbitLinesAlways setting to "Manual Orbit Line Visibility" to better represent what this setting now does.
Fix issue with secondary window resizing. Before this would keep losing focus while resizing the window. Now it doesn't anymore
Asset case fix for Linux
More asset fixes for linux
Final asset fixes for linux
Changed filtering for high eccentricity and hyperbolic orbits to filter taking into account Ap (inifinity - ok not really inifinity, more like Pi) and Pe.
More stable quadratic formula for ray-sphere intersections, fixes instability in atmospheric scattering when zooming out and observing the planet from very long distances

Move to ocean to its own pass, set it up to be able to write depth and color while reading previous resolved depth and color. Write to multi-sampled buffers with MSAA and read from resolved buffers. Perform a copy without MSAA.
Add refraction to the ocean
Make ocean write depth and remove atmosphere code ray-sphere intersection for ocean that was used as a temporary workaround
Reduce z-fighting and transparency issues around shores at long distances with MSAA. Still some medium distance issues with MSAA to investigate
Remove the input attachment pass for the offscreen target, it is currently unused and all our post processing effects need neighbour sampling
Add debug names to renderTagets in atmosphere, cloud and exhaust renderers
Minor refactors
Fixed same SOI transfers in transfer planner, not allowing enough dV in high gravity wells/SOI. Like say the Jovian system.
Remove old pbr shader comments The old pbr comments were making the shader files hard to read, so have been removed.

Changed double left click behavior for astronomicals. For Orbit Mode, it translates to maintain the position difference between the camera and the followed astronomical. For Map Mode, it centers the camera on the astronomical while maintaining the old position offset parallel to the camera's facing. Due to how Orbit Mode's camera reference frames work the camera has to rotate in any reference frame other than the Stars reference frame. I plan to counteract the rotation no matter the frame of reference when double clicking to easier maintain the player's visual context.
Removed Orbit Mode's map mode. The toggle map mode button now toggles between the new Map Mode and Orbit Mode.
Fixed a vector normalize in ScreenToEgo() that was dividing by zero in some cases.
Added the ability to hold the sprint key and more rapidly zoom in and out for Orbit Mode and Map Mode.
Fixed closest approach markers were not being drawn.
Added closest approach info back into Flight Plan UI.
Fixed menubar on secondary window occasionally losing focus and closing
More celestial text and UI rendering to the secondary windows
A couple of bugs left but almost all of the celestial UI is present now
Fixed issue on OrbitalTransfer.AlignmentTime. Longitude function returns degrees not radians, which it was assuming.
Fixed porkchop calculation thread was not being cancelled if the user changed the UI dropdown values while it was running, now when this happens the task is cancelled.
Added settings option for camera jump/interpolation speeds.
Switched map to use positioning more like orbit rotations with fixed axes based on the ecliptic plane.
Added a center keybind (default 'C') for the map to bring the camera back to the followed target after offsetting the camera.
Split map and orbit cameras to be two distinct cameras to support more seamless behavior when swapping.
Modified grid shader to use the camera's nearest point on the ecliptic plane as reference for scope rather than the center fragment's position as a ray intersecting with the ecliptic plane.
Forced own orbit to be shown when in map mode.
Fixed the comets, planets, moons orbit line toggles in the view menu getting out of sync with the show all and show none toggles.
Fixed input assignment checks ignoring modifier keys causing two inputs being processed. eg: "F"-only key assignment being processed even when modifiers were being held down at the same time.
Unstuck buttons when switching between controllers.
Modified map controller translations to be consistent along the non-Z ecliptic plane axes.
Modified the grid transparency to be 20%ish less.
Separate simple celestial updates from very complex vehicle updates to reduce vehicle update complexity and the risk of applying vehicle updates to celestials.
Hid mouse cursor when rotating the camera to help with excessive dragging.

Enabled raw mouse movement (when available) when the cursor is hidden. Documentation says this can help with dragging/rotation feel. I didn't notice a large change and if it causes problems feel free to revert.
Removed a couple of missed obsolete null/type checks for vehicle updates.
Fixed a few missed comments.

Tweaks to orbit line rendering filtering. Use the distance from the minima of the Ap or Pe to measure against the field of view instead of just the Pe. Do not exclude the Parent (of what the camera is following) object's orbit lines if outside the field of view. The parent is still filtered when too far from the camera to be meaningful.
Hooked up the burn UI multiplier for burns to the burn node gizmo logic to allow for setting custom multipliers when dragging.
Pulled in Brutal's networking API
Added ability to start server/host or connect to a game over LAN
Added simple chat messaging
Added terminal commands for testing
Fixed issue where modifier keys assigned to action input keys were not being handled after change done yesterday to not process input keys and modifiers twice.
More UI pushed to secondary windows
Fixed some visibility issues with Celestial UI on the secondary windows
Changed patch orbits to no longer fade along their path unless the patch is the final patch.
Changed the minimum opacity on orbit line fade to be slightly brighter so it's a bit easier to see.
